A passenger ferry carrying hundreds of people caught fire at sea on Sunday off Sulawesi island in Indonesia, killing at least five people, officials said. More than 280 people were rescued and evacuation efforts were ongoing.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 27 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 20 July 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales(Subic, Olongapo, San Antonio, San Marcelino, Castillejos).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Rizal, Quezon and Laguna within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Bulacan and Zambales(Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, Botolan, Cabangan, San Felipe, San Narciso) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
